body.summary: Add protected workflow admission and separate fresh-runner publication of unsigned artifacts. Enable after protected workflow deployment and rollout verification.
acceptanceChecks: Official receipt binds run, attempt, admitted ref and SHA, artifact ID, and independent digest without running candidate code.
Branch-local runs, forged receipts and wrong-attempt artifacts are rejected.
Hosted rollout checks run locally against fixtures. Deployment and enablement are separate from the local install gate.

tests.name: Hosted provenance fixture checks protected ref, isolated publisher, exact run attempt, artifact ID and measured digest
